description_full: Maase Inc. operates as an integrated provider and operator of artificial intelligence (AI) centric digital systems. The company focuses on areas of flexible energy deployment and intelligent commercial network operation, and provides closed-loop solutions from computing infrastructure, smart hardware and full-scene services. It also offers health and wellness products and services. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Laixi, China.
